title: Circles
intro: Small, private groups of close friends or classmates. Nothing is shared until you choose to share it.
emptyText: A circle is a few friends who can see each other showing up. Start one, then invite them with a link.
loadFailedText: Check your connection and try again.

new.title: Start a circle
new.description: Give it a name your friends will recognise.
new.label: Circle name

circle.notFoundText: It may have been closed, or you are no longer in it.
circle.week: {count, plural, =0 {A fresh week: nothing ticked in this circle yet.} one {This week the circle has ticked # habit.} other {This week the circle has ticked # habits.}}

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Anyone with this link can join until it stops working. That is in 7 days, or as soon as you make a new link.

join.title: Join {name}?
join.text: {count, plural, one {# person is} other {# people are}} in this circle.
join.invalidText: It has expired, or a newer link replaced it. Ask for a new one.
join.full: This circle is full, so no one else can join right now.
join.pairText: A pair is just the two of you. Nothing is shared until each of you chooses.

confirm.leaveText: What you shared there goes with you. You can be invited back.
confirm.closeText: This removes the circle for everyone in it. It cannot be undone.
confirm.removeText: They leave the circle, and what they shared there is removed.

sharing.title: What I share here
sharing.intro: Nothing is shared until you choose. Pick how much of each habit this circle sees. Misses are never shown.
sharing.pauseText: While on, nobody in any of your circles sees anything. Your choices are kept.
sharing.noHabits: You have no habits yet. Add one, then come back to share it.

help.hidden: This circle sees nothing about this habit.
help.showed_up: They only see that you showed up today, not which habit.
help.done_today: They see this habit and whether you did it today.
help.streaks: They also see your current streak.

sharing.levelFor: How much of {name} this circle sees
sharing.labelFor: How {name} is shown to this circle
sharing.overrideText: Give someone more or less than the rest of the circle. Changes apply right away.
sharing.showMisses: Show my off days for this one
sharing.introPair: Nothing is shared until you choose. Pick how much of each habit your partner sees. Off days show only when you both turn on Closer and you choose the habit.

member.history: {count} days ticked in the last {weeks} weeks
member.countMyWeek: Count my week with this circle

home.title: Circles
home.empty: Share your progress with a few close friends, only as much as you choose.

conversation.peopleLabel: See the {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} in this circle
conversation.peopleText: Everyone in the circle, and what each of them shares with you.
conversation.emptyText: When friends share a habit and do it, it shows up here, and you can cheer them on. Choose what you share to join in.
conversation.reactionLabel: {emoji} from {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

look.title: Circle settings
look.description: Only you see these choices. Friends see their own.
look.pinText: Keeps this circle first in your list.

pair.label: Partner
pair.waitingText: Send them your invite link. It is just the two of you, and nothing is shared until each of you chooses.
pair.subtitle: Cheering each other on
pair.subtitleCloser: Cheering each other on, with Closer on
pair.endText: This ends it for both of you. What you each shared here is removed.
pair.title: You & {name}

together.title: Week together
together.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No shared days yet. There is always today.} one {You both showed up on # day.} other {You both showed up on # days.}}
together.rowLabel: {name} showed up on {count} of the last 7 days.{off, plural, =0 {} one { One day didn't happen.} other { # days didn't happen.}}

closer.label: Let us see each other's off days
closer.text: It only works when you both turn it on. Either of you can turn it off, and it ends at once for both of you.
closer.waitingFor: Waiting for {name} to turn it on too.
closer.active: On for both of you. Below, choose which habits show their off days.
